title: Expeditions
hook: **Expeditions** are the idle RPG loop — pick spare demons, dispatch them, wait on a real-world timer, then collect.

blindSpots.meaning: An idle squad mission you start from the Expeditions layer (`E`). Not a lawn match and not a [delve](delve).
Send demons who are not on a live task. The timer starts when you confirm.
Claim the return when ready. Nothing expires if you forget — the report waits.
There is none. This build has no play-session stamina wall on expeditions.

alsoTrue: Expeditions are a sibling of the Delve, not a prototype to replace. Auto-resolve stays; interactive battles you play yourself are WIP elsewhere.
Quest- and world-event-starting ticks stay Vision — see [expedition event ticks](expedition-event-ticks).

sections.title: What it is
paras: Monster Hunter–style idle play that stays forever. Playable with the lawn game closed once the layer is open.
You pick demons, choose a duration tier, wait, and read the return report.
sections.note: The Expeditions layer opens from the Sanctum rail (`E`) once you have a **bound demon** to field.

sections.title: How it works
sections.intro: Four duration tiers are built for real schedules:

cards.name: While they are out
cards.body: A battle chain interleaved with quiet stretches, found souls, meeting a wild demon, or injuries. Outcome is sealed at dispatch by a recorded seed and revealed at collection.

cards.name: What you bring home
cards.body: Souls and summoner XP, specimen XP for demons who fought, a chance a wave demon [joins](wild-joins) the roster, and fusion materials ([essence](essence)). Materials feed actors and empire — never loam.

diagram: pick spare demons  ->  dispatch  ->  wait  ->  collect

groups.title: From the Sanctum
groups.intro: Expeditions sit on the layer rail.
steps: Open Expeditions (`E`) when the rail shows it.
Pick demons who are not on a live task.
Choose a duration tier, dispatch, then collect when the timer finishes (or [recall](expedition-slots-recall) early).
groups.note: Start short. Grow into overnight runs when the roster can carry them.

doSteps: Bind at least one demon so Expeditions can open.
Open Expeditions (`E`), pick a short tier and a spare squad, and dispatch.
Collect when ready and read the return report once.
doNote: Stop when dispatch → wait → collect is clear. Next: [slots and recall](expedition-slots-recall).

mixUps.q: Do I need the lawn game open?
mixUps.a: No. Once unlocked, expeditions run from the control room with the lawn closed.
No. Delves are a separate Vision stage. Expeditions stay the async idle loop.
No. There is no stamina gate on expeditions.

mixUps.q: Do rewards expire if I forget to collect?
mixUps.a: No. Collect when you are ready.
Full quest and world-event ticks are Vision — see [expedition event ticks](expedition-event-ticks).
